title: National Partnership Emails — 2013
notes: The archive contains emails to the National Partnership Google Group and explicitly labels recurring lists as Additions, with running membership and presbytery counts.

The 2013 archive begins with a running total of 94 elders in 38 presbyteries rather than a complete baseline roster. Therefore the extract can establish named additions and other explicit membership references, but cannot by itself reconstruct all 94 baseline members.
Candidate support, fellowship invitations, and praise are not treated as proof of National Partnership membership.
A binary repository copy should be added when available; until then the manifest preserves the public mirror and exact evidence locations used for normalization.
